children: and offered a stronger-than-expected full-year outlook and the executive appointment of Stephen Cumming as Senior Vice President and CFO.
For the Q4, Penguin Solutions delivered net sales of $567M, up 68% Y/Y from $338M in the prior-year period and comfortably exceeding consensus analyst estimates by $46.01M.
Growth was primarily driven by accelerated demand in its data center market and non-hyperscale AI infrastructure solutions, alongside integrated memory.
Adjusted non-GAAP diluted earnings per share surged 133% Y/Y to $1.00, widely topping estimates.

The company's performance was bolstered by robust customer expansion, including six new AI infrastructure clients signed during the quarter. AI-driven lines of business generated 78% of total quarterly net sales, with non-hyperscale AI infrastructure growing 99% Y/Y and integrated memory sales surging 158% to a record $341M.
Penguin Solutions ended fiscal 2026 with a record backlog, as overall bookings outpaced sales.
Looking ahead, management provided an upbeat outlook for fiscal 2027, projecting net sales growth of roughly 40% Y/Y to approximately $2.43B at the midpoint
. Full-year diluted EPS for fiscal 2027 is forecasted to grow roughly 55% to $4.45 per share at the midpoint
Stephen Cumming as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective October 6, 2026.

title: Penguin Solutions jumps premarket following strong Q4 beat, upbeat outlook, and CFO appointment
